description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into an Airtable table via the native server-side upsert endpoint. `PATCH /v0/{baseId}/{tableName}?performUpsert[fieldsToMergeOn][]=<field>` atomically creates or updates records based on matching key_fields.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Airtable record (upserted via key_fields).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata. No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Airtable.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

table.label: Table
table.description: Target table name or ID (starts with 'tbl').

key_fields.label: Key Fields
key_fields.description: Airtable field name(s) to match on. Airtable's server-side upsert matches rows where ALL listed fields equal the incoming row's values.

typecast.label: Typecast
typecast.description: If true, Airtable coerces string values into typed fields (e.g. dates, selects).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). Airtable batches at 10 per API call -- the resource chunks automatically.

name: Airtable Record Upsert
